tasks.label: Docusaurus: Stop
args: $workspace = '${workspaceFolder}\docs'; $processes = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'node.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine.Contains($workspace) -and $_.CommandLine -match 'docusaurus.*start' }; if (-not $processes) { Write-Output 'No Docusaurus process found for this workspace.'; exit 0 }; foreach ($process in $processes) { & taskkill.exe /PID $process.ProcessId /T /F; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }
